about.title: American Canyon Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: American Canyon sits along a stretch of Napa County where daily traffic funnels through Broadway, American Canyon Road, Rt 29, and Flosden Road. Public collision counts show 31 injury crashes and 46 injured people in the most recent full year, with Tuesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. showing up often in reported incidents. Whether you were rear-ended near a Rt 29 intersection or sideswiped on Flosden Road, the aftermath usually means medical appointments, missed work, and calls from an insurance adjuster who wants a recorded statement fast. LawProactive doesn't practice law itself — we're a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney who can look at what happened, help you understand your options under California law, and handle communications with insurers so you can focus on recovering. There's no obligation to move forward, and no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Settling

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident claim in California, but that window shrinks to as little as six months if a government vehicle or road defect is involved. An attorney can help make sure a claim isn't filed too late.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but any percentage assigned to you reduces your compensation. Insurers often use recorded statements to shift blame, which is why it helps to have someone reviewing what you say before you say it.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering, No Fee Unless You Win
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases, and attorneys in this network work on contingency, meaning there's no upfront cost and no fee unless you recover.

items.question: I was in a crash near the Rt 29 and American Canyon Road area — what should I do first?
items.answer: Get medical attention even if you feel okay, since some injuries show up later. Try to document the scene with photos if you're able, and avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer before speaking with an attorney. LawProactive can connect you with someone who can advise on next steps at no cost.

items.question: How long do I have to bring a claim after a car accident in American Canyon?
items.answer: California generally gives you two years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit. That deadline can be much shorter, sometimes six months, if your claim involves a government entity like a city road or public vehicle. An attorney can help identify which deadline applies to your situation.

items.question: What if the insurance company says I was partly at fault?
items.answer: California follows pure comparative fault, so you can still recover damages even if you share some blame, though your total compensation gets reduced by your percentage of fault. Insurers sometimes push hard on fault percentages to lower payouts. An independent attorney can help push back on unfair fault assessments.
